rules.title: Flixel 2.x library in use
rules.explanation: The project uses the Flixel library. The converter maps org.flixel to a C# port of Flixel 2.x that is added to the migrated copy.
rules.resolution: No action. The runtime project XnaReborn.Flixel is generated next to the game.

rules.title: Flixel version is not 2.x
rules.explanation: The bundled Flixel source reports a version other than 2.x. The runtime port follows the Flixel 2.5x API, so calls may not match.
rules.resolution: Check the markers for missing Flixel members, or port the game to Flixel 2.5x first.

rules.title: Compiled .swf without source
rules.explanation: Only a compiled .swf was found. XNA Reborn does not decompile Flash files.
rules.resolution: Provide the ActionScript source project.

rules.title: Flash Pro timeline project
rules.explanation: A .fla or .xfl timeline project holds art and code in a Flash Pro document. Timelines have no counterpart in the Flixel runtime.
rules.resolution: Move the code to ActionScript classes and export the art as image files.

rules.title: Other .swc library dependency
rules.explanation: A compiled .swc library has no source the converter can read.
rules.resolution: Add the library source to the project, or replace the library with a C# equivalent.

rules.title: Embedded image
rules.explanation: [Embed] images become texture entries in the MonoGame content project.
rules.resolution: No action. The converter adds the file to Content.mgcb.

rules.title: Embedded audio
rules.explanation: [Embed] sounds become sound or song entries in the content project. MP3 may need ffmpeg on the build machine.
rules.resolution: No action unless the content build reports a missing audio tool.

rules.title: Embedded data file
rules.explanation: Data embeds such as tile map CSV or XML files are copied to the Content folder and read at run time.
rules.resolution: No action.

rules.title: Embedded font
rules.explanation: Embedded fonts are replaced by a sprite font built from an installed font, so glyph shapes can differ.
rules.resolution: Check the text in the running game.

rules.title: Embed from SWF symbol
rules.explanation: Embedding a symbol from a .swf needs the Flash asset format, which is not read.
rules.resolution: Export the symbol as an image or sound file and embed that.

rules.title: Embed source file missing
rules.explanation: An [Embed] tag points to a file that does not exist, or one outside the project folder.
rules.resolution: Restore the file or fix the path in the [Embed] tag.

rules.title: 'with' statement
rules.explanation: C# has no 'with' statement. The converter leaves a marker and the original text.
rules.resolution: Rewrite the block with explicit member access.

rules.title: E4X XML expressions
rules.explanation: XML literals and E4X operators (.@, .., .( )) are not converted.
rules.resolution: Rewrite with System.Xml.Linq.

rules.title: 'arguments' object
rules.explanation: The arguments object has no C# counterpart.
rules.resolution: Use a rest parameter (params object[]).

rules.title: Untyped variable or '*' type
rules.explanation: Untyped values become 'dynamic' in C#, which is slower and defers errors to run time.
rules.resolution: Add a type annotation in the ActionScript, or accept 'dynamic'.

rules.title: Dynamic class
rules.explanation: A dynamic class can gain properties at run time. C# classes cannot.
rules.resolution: Move the extra data into a dictionary or declared fields.

rules.title: Namespace declaration or 'use namespace'
rules.explanation: AS3 namespaces and the :: operator have no direct C# form.
rules.resolution: Replace with access modifiers or plain names.

rules.title: Function values and closures
rules.explanation: Function expressions and function-typed values become AsFunction.
rules.resolution: No action.

rules.title: Integer division changes meaning
rules.explanation: In AS3, dividing two ints gives a Number. In C# it gives an int. The converter casts the left operand to double.
rules.resolution: No action.

rules.title: Number default is NaN
rules.explanation: An AS3 Number without an initializer starts as NaN. C# doubles start as 0. The converter writes double.NaN.
rules.resolution: No action.

rules.title: 'Object' used as a property bag
rules.explanation: Object literals and indexed Object access become AsObject, a string keyed dictionary.
rules.resolution: Check that no code relies on prototype features.

rules.title: Regular expression literal
rules.explanation: Regular expression literals are not converted in the first slice.
rules.resolution: Rewrite with System.Text.RegularExpressions.

rules.title: Reflection by name
rules.explanation: getDefinitionByName and ApplicationDomain look up classes by name at run time.
rules.resolution: Replace with a table of class references.

rules.title: flash.display used outside Flixel
rules.explanation: Display list classes (Sprite, Bitmap, Stage) have no counterpart in the Flixel runtime.
rules.resolution: Move the drawing into Flixel sprites.

rules.title: flash.events custom events
rules.explanation: Game-defined events need the event dispatcher classes.
rules.resolution: Stretch task: AsEventDispatcher.

rules.title: flash.media used directly
rules.explanation: Direct use of Sound and SoundChannel is not mapped.
rules.resolution: Use FlxSound or FlxG.play.

rules.title: flash.net used directly
rules.explanation: Network, URL loading and SharedObject use is not converted.
rules.resolution: Use FlxSave for saved data and remove network calls.

rules.title: flash.external or Security
rules.explanation: These talk to the browser page or the Flash security sandbox.
rules.resolution: Remove the calls.

rules.title: Filters and blend modes
rules.explanation: Display filters and blend modes are not part of the Flixel runtime.
rules.resolution: Remove the effect or draw it in a shader by hand.

rules.title: Ad, sponsor or score SDK
rules.explanation: Web portal SDKs talk to online services that need the Flash player.
rules.resolution: Remove the calls.

rules.title: Preloader
rules.explanation: The [Frame(factoryClass)] preloader is dropped. A desktop game loads from disk.
rules.resolution: No action.

rules.title: Flixel debugger settings
rules.explanation: The Flixel debugger overlay does not exist in the runtime.
rules.resolution: No action.

rules.title: Flixel pixel access
rules.explanation: Reading or writing sprite pixels needs a CPU bitmap, which the first slice does not have.
rules.resolution: Stretch task: AsBitmapData.

rules.title: Flixel stage access
rules.explanation: FlxG.stage exposes the Flash stage, which does not exist.
rules.resolution: Use FlxG.width, FlxG.height and the game window instead.

rules.title: Flixel plugins or replay
rules.explanation: Flixel plugins and input replay are not part of the runtime.
rules.resolution: Remove the plugin or port it by hand.

rules.title: No or several FlxGame entry classes
rules.explanation: The converter needs exactly one class that extends FlxGame.
rules.resolution: Keep one entry class, or remove the unused ones from the project.
